job_description: ALTEN MAROC,a subsidiary of the global leader in engineering and technology consulting, founded in 2008 and present in Fez, Rabat, Tetouan, and Casablanca, currently has more than 2,200 employees and is aiming for a center of excellence of 3,300 ALTEN employees by the end of 2027.
